name: access-termonal-blue
features: Boba shop themed sign in page with shop ID and passcode fields.
Password strength meter scores the passcode as it is typed.
Open Shop shows a result message after checking the password rules.
Live open now clock displays on the page.
keepSeparate: Intentionally separate. The access terminal family is kept apart for experimentation and may grow. The merge layer skips it.
futureIdea: Possible fun merge of this login screen with the boba-breakeven game later. Not now.
